# Regulatory Compliance and Risk Monitoring

This document details critical monitoring and investigation tasks for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Monitor regulatory changes quarterly.
*   Investigate legal risks for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor legal risks quarterly.
*   Review AML detection based on audit findings.
*   Investigate internal control standard updates.
